description: A parenthesized call site with too few arguments for a user procedure raises ol-not-enough-inputs at the callee span, checked at runtime call time (execute() runs check() before Phase 2); shares the callable/expected/actual param shape with #111's static rule (spec/error-model.md). Issue #97. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
